mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_log ( mk_meal_type, mk_image, mk_usermemo, user_num ) VALUES ( #{mkMealType}, #{mkImage}, #{mkUserMemo}, #{userNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT fo_num AS foNum, fo_name AS foName, fo_base_gram AS foBaseGram, fo_kcal AS foKcal, fo_carbs AS foCarbs, fo_protein AS foProtein, fo_fat AS foFat, fo_natrium AS foNatrium, fo_type AS foType FROM food WHERE fo_name = #{foName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_detail ( md_kcal, md_portion, mk_num, fo_num, mday_num ) VALUES ( #{mdKcal}, #{mdPortion}, #{mkNum}, #{foNum}, #{mdayNum} )
INSERT INTO meal_week ( mm_num, mw_year, mw_month, mw_week ) VALUES ( #{mmNum}, #{mwYear}, #{mwMonth}, #{mwWeek} )
mapper.select: SELECT md.md_num AS mdNum, md.md_kcal AS mdKcal, md.md_portion AS mdPortion, md.mk_num AS mkNum, md.fo_num AS foNum, md.mday_num AS mdayNum, f.fo_name AS foName, ml.mk_meal_type AS mkMealType FROM meal_detail md JOIN meal_log ml ON md.mk_num = ml.mk_num JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num WHERE ml.user_num = #{userNum} AND DATE(ml.mk_created_at) = #{date} ORDER BY ml.mk_created_at DESC, md.md_num DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mk_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS recordedDate FROM meal_log WHERE user_num = #{userNum} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mk_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY recordedDate
